comment: A Tourist with 10 hit points breaks a wished-for wand of digging in debug mode and answers y at Die?. apply.c do_break_wand() reaches its general explode(), whose fatal magical blast reaches end.c done(); C's done() never returns, so the per-square digging loop and its rn2(obj->spe) draws never run. Answering q at the disclosure prompt and n at Save bones? ends the game.
